data.value: HEAD is detached. Switch to a branch before you push.

data.value: Sign-in failed. Set up a credential helper (for example Git Credential Manager) or load your SSH key into the agent.

data.name: HostKeyHint
data.value: The SSH host key of the server is unknown. Connect to the server once in a terminal, for example with ssh -T, check the key and accept it. The editor does not accept host keys by itself.

data.name: PushRejectedHint
data.value: The remote rejected the push. Usually it has commits your branch does not have yet: pull first, then push again.

data.name: PullDivergedHint
data.value: Your branch and its upstream have diverged, so a fast-forward is not possible. Merge or rebase in a terminal for now.

data.name: TimeoutHint
data.value: Git did not finish in time and was stopped. Check the network connection and try again.

data.name: FetchPartlyFailedFormat
data.value: Fetched {0}, but the other remotes failed. {1}

data.name: SyncPushFailedFormat
data.value: The pull of {1} into {0} completed, but the push failed. {2}

data.name: LogProgressDialogFailed
data.value: The progress dialog could not be shown. The Git command runs without it.

data.name: ForbiddenHint
data.value: The server accepted the sign-in but denies access to the repository. Check your permissions on the remote.

data.name: NetworkHint
data.value: The server could not be reached. Check the network connection and the remote URL.

data.name: RemoteRejectedHint
data.value: The remote declined the push, for example because the branch is protected or a server hook refused it. Pulling does not help. Push to another branch or ask the owner of the repository.

data.value: Unstages the selected lines of the diff, or the hunk at the cursor, of a staged change.

data.value: Select changed lines in the diff of the Git Changes panel or place the cursor in a hunk. Untracked files and files with conflicts are only staged or discarded as a whole.

data.value: Discard the selected changes of {0}? They are not stored anywhere.

data.value: The selection would join the last line of the file, which has no line break, with the next line. Select the removed and the added last line together.

data.name: PatchMultipleFiles

data.name: PatchUnavailable
data.value: The git service of this application cannot stage selected lines or amend commits.

data.name: NoBranchToMerge

data.name: MergeUnavailable
data.value: The git service of this application cannot merge.

data.name: MergeReadyToCommit

data.name: OperationReadyToContinue
data.value: no conflicts left, Continue goes on
